correctness.rationale: Two-variable rank-r pair types reduce to unary rank-r types at endpoints plus atomic equality, forward and reverse successor relations. Existential quantification records only support, not neighbor counts; hence unary colors refine by (old color, set of atomic-relation/old-color pairs). Inductively for n≥2r+3 there are one marked, r forward, r reverse, and one far class; far block lengths 2,3,≥4 at next step separate the two border cases from stable range by existence of nonadjacent same-far-color vertex. Therefore rank-q sentence palettes distinguish exactly 3..2q individually and stabilize at 2q+1. Independently canonicalized unary support types across all n=3..24 and checked every pair/rank for q=1..8; full all-q proof is structural induction.
residual_risks: Algebraic finite checks do not alone establish infinite theorems; analytical proof independently reconstructed.
